title: Simulation 3D SpaceMouse
text: Process input from space mouse device, 3 outputs, {Output type} sets Type of output; {Port} sets the serial port where mouse, {Dominant mode} sets the option to accept only prevailing movement, {Disable position movement} sets the option to fix rotations at initial values, {Disable rotation movement} sets the option to fix positions at initial values, {Normalize output angle} sets the option to determine whether rotation angles should wrap in full, {Limit position} sets the option to limit position of mouse, {Position sensitivity} sets the mouse sensitivity for translations, {Rotation sensitivity} sets the mouse sensitivity for rotations, {Initial position} sets the initial condition for translations, {Initial rotation} sets the initial condition for rotations, {Lower position limit} sets the lower limit of mouse and {Upper position limit} sets the upper limit of mouse. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Translation
ports.summary: Status of object translation 1 or true | 0 or false

ports.name: Rotation
ports.summary: Status of object rotation 1 or true | 0 or false

ports.name: Buttons
ports.summary: Status of button 1 or true | 0 or false

params.name: Port
params.values: Serial port where mouse is connected COM1 (default) | COM2 | COM3 | COM4 | USB1 | USB2 | USB3 | USB4

params.name: Output type
params.values: Type of output Speed (default) | Position | Viewpoint coordinates

params.name: Dominant mode
params.values: Option to accept only prevailing movement and rotation off (default) | on

params.name: Disable position movement
params.values: Option to fix rotations at initial values off (default) | on

params.name: Disable rotation movement
params.values: Option to fix positions at initial values off (default) | on

params.name: Normalize output angle
params.values: Option to determine whether rotation angles should wrap in full circle off (default) | on

params.name: Limit position
params.values: Option to limit position of mouse off (default) | on
